title: The legend of the river Ganga
introduction: Sage Vishvamitra along with others reach the banks of River Ganga and they make their sojourn on that riverbank. There when Rama inquisitively enquires about River Ganga Vishvamitra narrates the legend of Ganga, as to how she is taken to heavens by gods from her father Himalayas.
closing: इति वाल्मीकिरामायणे आदिकाव्ये बालकाण्डे पंचत्रिंशः सर्गः
Thus, this is the 35th chapter in Bala Kanda of Valmiki Ramayana, the First Epic poem of India.

verses.devanagari:
उपास्य रात्रिशेषं तु शोणाकूले महर्षिभिः |
निशायां सुप्रभातायां विश्वामित्रोऽभ्यभाषत
verses.iast:
upāsya rātri śeṣam tu śoṇā kūle maharṣibhiḥ |
niśāyām suprabhātāyām viśvāmitro abhyabhāṣata
verses.translation: On sojourning the remaining night on the bank of river Sona along with great-sages, Viswamitra spoke when that night is elapsing into a sunny daybreak.

glosses.meaning: with great-sages, Sona [the river,] on its bank, on sojourning

verses.devanagari:
सुप्रभाता निशा राम पूर्वा संध्या प्रवर्तते |
उत्तिष्ठोत्तिष्ठ भद्रं ते गमनायाभिरोचय
verses.iast:
suprabhātā niśā rāma pūrvā sandhyā pravartate |
uttiṣṭha uttiṣṭha bhadram te gamanāya abhirocaya
verses.translation: "Oh, Rama, night fared into a sunny morning, eastern day-spring is set in, hence awake and arise, you be safe, ready yourself for further travel."

glosses.meaning: for travel, be inspired to - ready yourself.

verses.devanagari:
तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं तस्य कृत्वा पौर्वाह्णिकक्रियः |
गमनं रोचयामास वाक्यं चेदमुवाच ह
verses.iast:
tat śrutvā vacanam tasya kṛtvā paurva āhṇika kriyaḥ |
gamanam rocayāmāsa vākyam ca idam uvāca ha
verses.translation: On hearing the words of Sage Vishvamitra, Rama woke up and on completion of morning time religious activities he readied himself for further journey and indeed spoke this sentence to the sage.

glosses.meaning: early, morning, religious activities, on performing

verses.devanagari:
अयं शोणः शुभजलोऽगाधः पुलिनमण्डितः |
कतरेण पथा ब्रह्मन् संतरिष्यामहे वयम्
verses.iast:
ayam śoṇaḥ śubha jalo gādhaḥ pulina maṇḍitaḥ |
katareṇa pathā brahman santariṣyāmahe vayam
verses.translation: "This River Sona is with auspicious waters and even adorned with dunes, where it is not so deep. Oh, Brahman, in which of the two ways, namely by fordless waters or by fordable water with dunes, we have to cross this river?"

glosses.meaning: we, in which of the two, ways
very, easily cross it over - rather, without a boat

verses.devanagari:
एवमुक्तस्तु रामेण विश्वामित्रोऽब्रवीदिदम् |
एष पंथा मयोद्दिष्टो येन यान्ति महर्षयः
verses.iast:
evam uk{}taḥ tu rāmeṇa viśvāmitro abravīt idam |
eṣa panthā mayā uddiṣṭo yena yānti maharṣayaḥ
verses.translation: When Rama spoke to him thus sage Vishvamitra replied, "I propose the same route by which these great sages are going.

glosses.meaning: thus, one who is spoken, Vishvamitra
that, route, by me, is proposed.

verses.devanagari:
एवमुक्त्वा महर्षयो विश्वमित्रेण धीमता |
पश्यन्तस्ते प्रयाता वै वनानि विविधानि च
verses.iast:
evam uk{}tvā maharṣayo viśvamitreṇa dhīmatā |
paśyantaḥ te prayātā vai vanāni vividhāni ca
verses.translation: Thus spoken by that astute Sage Vishvamitra, the other great sages travelled on, indeed beholding diverse forests and their environs.

glosses.meaning: by astute one, Vishvamitra, thus, said

verses.devanagari:
ते गत्वा दूरमध्वानं गतेऽर्धदिवसे तदा |
जाह्नवीं सरितां श्रेष्ठां ददृशुर्मुनिसेविताम्
verses.iast:
te gatvā dūram adhvānam gate ardha divase tadā |
jāhnavīm saritām śreṣṭhām dadṛśur muni sevitām
verses.translation: On going a distance on their way, and after a lapse of half a day, then they perceived the prominent one among rivers and the one adored by sages, namely River Ganga.

glosses.meaning: they, a distance, on their way, on going

verses.devanagari:
तां दृष्ट्वा पुण्यसलिलां हंससारससेविताम् |
बभूवुर्मुनयः सर्वे मुदिताः सहराघवाः
verses.iast:
tām dṛṣṭvā puṇya salilām haṃsa sārasa sevitām |
babhūvur munayaḥ sarve muditā saha rāghavāḥ
verses.translation: On seeing River Ganga with her pious waters and adored by swans and saarasa waterfowls, all the sages felt delighted together with both of the Raghava-s, namely Rama and Lakshmana.

glosses.meaning: by swans, by saarasa [waterfowls,] adored by
along with, Raghava-s, Rama and Lakshmana

verses.devanagari:
तस्यास्तीरे तदा सर्वे चक्रुर्वासपरिग्रहम् |
ततः स्नात्वा यथान्यायं संतर्प्य पितृदेवताः
हुत्वा चैवाग्निहोत्राणि प्राश्य चामृतवद्धविः |
विविशुर्जाह्नवीतीरे शुभा मुदितमानसाः
विश्वामित्रं महात्मानं परिवार्य समंततः |
verses.iast:
tasyāḥ tīre tataḥ cakruḥ te āvāsa parigraham |
tataḥ snātvā yathā nyāyam santarpya pitṛ devatāḥ
hutvā caiva agnihotrāṇi prāśya ca amṛtavat haviḥ |
viviśur jāhnavī tīre śubhā mudita mānasāḥ
viśvāmitram mahātmānam parivārya samantataḥ |
verses.translation: Then they sojourned on the riverbank of Ganga, and next on taking bath in Ganga they have customarily offered that river's water as oblations to their manes. After that, on enkindling the ritual-fire they have also offered fire-oblations into it for gods. Later, dining on their part of those ambrosian oblations with which they have oblated the fire, those sages perched on the propitious banks of Ganga, surrounding the great-souled Vishvamitra from all sides, to the contentment of their heart in having performed religious chores on the riverbank of Ganga.

glosses.meaning: sojourn, taking, they have done - they camped there
ritual fire, enkindled, also, thus - performed fire oblations
contented, at hearts - in oblating at river Ganga
on propitious, Ganga, on the banks

verses.devanagari:
विष्टिताश्च यथान्यायं राघवौ च यथा अर्हम् |
संप्रहृष्टमना रामो विश्वामित्रमथाब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
viṣṭitāḥ ca yathā nyāyam rāghavo ca yathā arham |
samprahṛṣṭa manā rāmo viśvāmitram atha abravīt
verses.translation: When sages are sitting at ease then even Rama and Lakshmana sat down according to their admissibility and custom of sitting before their teachers, and then Rama highly gladdened at heart has spoken to Vishvamitra.

verses.devanagari:
भगवन् श्रोतुमिच्छामि गङ्गां त्रिपथगां नदीम् |
त्रैलोक्यं कथमाक्रम्य गता नदनदीपतिम्
verses.iast:
bhagavan śrotum icchāmi gañgām tri patha gām nadīm |
trailokyam katham ākraṃya gatā nada nadīpatim
verses.translation: "Oh, godly sage, I wish to listen about Ganga, the river that has a trinal course, and as to how she is reaching the husband of rivulets and rivers, namely the ocean, on pervading all the three worlds." Thus Rama asked Vishvamitra.

glosses.meaning: at rivulet, river, husband of - ocean

verses.devanagari:
चोदितो रामवाक्येन विश्वामित्रो महामुनिः |
वृद्धिं जन्म च गंगाया वक्तुमेवोपचक्रमे
verses.iast:
codito rāma vākyena viśvāmitro mahāmuniḥ |
vṛddhim janma ca gaṅgāyā vak{}tum eva upacakrame
verses.translation: Motivated by Rama's words the eminent-sage Vishvamitra commenced to narrate about the emergence and that way even about the progression of River Ganga.

verses.devanagari:
शैलेन्द्रो हिमवान् राम धातूनामाकरो महान् |
तस्य कन्याद्वयं राम रूपेणाप्रतिमं भुवि
verses.iast:
śailendro himavān rāma dhātūnām ākaro mahān |
tasya kanyā dvayam rāma rūpeṇa apratimam bhuvi
verses.translation: "The lordly mountain Himavan who is the greatest treasure trove of minerals, Rama, also treasures up a pair of daughters who by their comeliness are unequalled on earth.

glosses.meaning: for minerals, greatest, repository - treasure trove of

verses.devanagari:
या मेरुदुहिता राम तयोर्माता सुमध्यमा |
नाम्ना मेना मनोज्ञा वै पत्नी हिमवतः प्रिया
verses.iast:
yā meru duhitā rāma tayor mātā sumadhyamā |
nāmnā menā manoGYā vai patnī himavataḥ priyā
verses.translation: "The slender-waisted and fascinating daughter of Mt. Meru, oh, Rama, renowned by her name Mena, is the dear wife of Himavan and the mother of those two daughters, indeed.

glosses.meaning: by name, Mena, [she who is renowned like that]
she who is, Mt. Meru's, daughter

verses.devanagari:
तस्यां गंगेयमभवज्ज्येष्ठा हिमवतः सुता |
उमा नाम द्वितीयाभूत्कन्या तस्यैव राघव
verses.iast:
tasyām gaṅga iyam abhavat jyeṣṭhā himavataḥ sutā |
umā nāma dvitīyā abhūt kanyā tasya eva rāghava
verses.translation: "This Ganga has emerged as an elder daughter to Himavan through Mena, oh, Raghava, and that way a girl renowned by the name Uma has become a second daughter to him.

verses.devanagari:
अथ ज्येष्ठां सुराः सर्वे देवकार्यचिकीर्षया |
शैलेन्द्रं वरयामासुर्गंगां त्रिपथगां नदीम्
verses.iast:
atha jyeṣṭhām surāḥ sarve deva kārya cikīrṣayā |
śailendram varayāmāsuḥ gaṅgām tri patha gām nadīm
verses.translation: "Later, all of the divinities intending to fulfil a divine purpose have sought the lordly mountain Himavan to spare Ganga, who is scheduled to become a tri-way-cruising river.

glosses.meaning: who will ultimately become - three, way, cruising, river
mountain, lordly one - Himavan, sought him.

verses.devanagari:
ददौ धर्मेण हिमवांस्तनयां लोकपावनीम् |
स्वच्छंदपथगां गंगां त्रैलोक्यहितकाम्यया
verses.iast:
dadau dharmeṇa himavān tanayām loka pāvanīm |
svacchanda patha gām gaṅgām trailokya hita kāṃyayā
verses.translation: "With a righteous thinking and hopeful of the welfare in triadic world, Himavan then spared his daughter Ganga whose flow is at her own volition.

glosses.meaning: for three, worlds, welfare, hopeful of
worlds, one who is a sanctifier
volitionally, in her way, on who flows

verses.devanagari:
प्रतिगृह्य त्रिलोकार्थं त्रिलोकहितकांक्षिणः |
गंगामादाय तेऽगच्छन् कृतार्थेनान्तरात्मना
verses.iast:
pratigṛhya triloka artham triloka hita kāṅkśiṇaḥ |
gaṅgām ādāya te agacchan kṛtārthena antarātmanā
verses.translation: "Those divinities who are the well-wishers of the well-being of tri-world welcomed Ganga, who is incidentally intended for the purpose of the tri-world, and they came back to heaven fetching Ganga with them, with a heartfelt joy for their purpose is fulfilled.

glosses.meaning: for three, world's, well-being, wishing [she who causes weal]
in turn, taking [on receiving, welcoming,] took with them
fulfilled, of purpose, in inner, soul

verses.devanagari:
या चान्या शैलदुहिता कन्यासीद्रघुनंदन |
उग्रं सा व्रतमास्थाय तपस्तेपे तपोधना
verses.iast:
yā ca anyā śaila duhitā kanyā āsīt raghunandana |
ugram suvratam āsthāya tapaḥ tepe tapodhanā
verses.translation: "The other daughter of Himavanta, oh, Raghu's descendent, that unmarried girl namely Uma, she performed a rigorous sacrament taking hold of a supreme devoutness as her ascesis itself is her wealth.

glosses.meaning: rigorous, supreme, devoutness, taking hold of

verses.devanagari:
उग्रेण तपसा युक्तां ददौ शैलवरः सुताम् |
रुद्रायाप्रतिरूपाय उमां लोकनमस्कृताम्
verses.iast:
ugreṇa tapasā yuk{}tām dadau śailavaraḥ sutām |
rudrāya apratirūpāya umām loka namaskṛtām
verses.translation: "As for Uma who is unified with her rigorous sacrament and who is adored by all the world, that best one among mountains Himavanta gave such a daughter to the unique god Rudra.

glosses.meaning: one who is - rigorous, sacrament, unified with
one who is - by worlds, adored
one with - no, coequal, in aspect [unequalled one, unique god]

verses.devanagari:
एते ते शैलराजस्य सुते लोकनमस्कृते |
गंगा च सरितां श्रेष्ठा उमादेवी च राघव
verses.iast:
ete te śaila rājasya sute loka namaskṛte |
gaṅgā ca saritām śreṣṭhā umādevī ca rāghava
verses.translation: "Oh, Raghava, the prominent one among rivers namely Ganga and Uma Devi as well, these are the two daughters of the king of mountains that are highly revered by the world.

glosses.meaning: among rivers, prominent one Ganga, also
these, they two, mountain, king's - Himavan's

verses.devanagari:
एतत्ते सर्वमाख्यातं यथा त्रिपथगामिनी |
खं गता प्रथमं तात गतिं गतिमतां वर
verses.iast:
etat te sarvam ākhyātam yathā tri patha gāminī |
kham gatā prathamam tāta gatim gatimatām vara
verses.translation: "Dear boy Rama with beautiful gait, as to how the triply coursing Ganga has cruised to heaven in the first phase, I have related all about that cruise to you.
notes: The three-way coursing of the river is firstly as Ganga in the lap of Himalayas. Then when she cruised heavenward with divinities as Deva Ganga, or Mandaakini or Sudiirghika, it is second. Later, when she came to earth from heaven and gone into ocean and even to netherworlds as Jahnavi, it is the third. There are variations for this. Some say that the river's entry into sky is the first, by taking words gati matām vara, gati and deriving meaning as - which sky grants a path for all moving things etc., and the next is her entry to heaven, and nextly her coming to earth. And some say that gods have not left her in middle of the sky to come to heaven at a later time, and hence her three courses are as Ganga, Mandaakini, and Jahnavi.

glosses.meaning: in cruising, [of life] of people, best one
to you, all in all, is related.

verses.devanagari:
सैषा सुरनदी रम्या शैलेन्द्रतनया तदा |
सुरलोकं समारूढा विपापा जलवाहिनी
verses.iast:
sa eṣā sura nadī raṃyā śailendra tanayā tadā |
sura lokam samārūḍhā vipāpā jala vāhinī
verses.translation: "As such, that marvellous and sinless daughter of the lordly mountain Himavanta, ever-flowing in the form of water, ascended to the abode of divinities and became deva ganga , Divine River.

glosses.meaning: in the form of waters, one that flows
